research-industry.label: 行业趋势
research-industry.description: 梳理行业现状与发展方向
research-industry.prompt: 请对我指定的行业进行深度调研，梳理市场规模、主要参与者、关键趋势、机会与风险，并给出有来源依据的结论。

research-competitors.label: 竞品分析
research-competitors.description: 比较竞品能力与市场定位
research-competitors.prompt: 请完成一份竞品分析，比较主要产品的定位、目标用户、核心功能、价格、优势短板和差异化机会，并用表格总结。

research-policy.label: 政策分析
research-policy.description: 解读政策影响与执行要点
research-policy.prompt: 请分析我提供的政策或法规，提炼核心要求、适用范围、时间节点、对业务的影响和落地建议，标注不确定信息。

research-literature.label: 文献综述
research-literature.description: 整理研究脉络与关键观点
research-literature.prompt: 请围绕指定主题撰写文献综述框架，归纳主要研究观点、方法、共识、争议与研究空白，并提出后续研究问题。

research-user.label: 用户调研
research-user.description: 访谈与需求洞察调研报告
research-user.prompt:
请帮我完成一次目标用户调研，并输出一份调研报告。调研对象是一线使用者，围绕他们在真实工作中遇到的问题展开。

报告需要包含：访谈样本构成与调研方法说明、用户当前的工作流程与卡点、需求优先级排序及判断依据、典型用户原话摘录、可直接落地的产品建议。所有结论都要标注来源，不能只给观点。

research-market-entry.label: 市场进入评估
research-market-entry.description: 新市场进入的可行性分析
research-market-entry.prompt:
请对我指定的市场做一次进入可行性评估，从需求规模、获客成本、合规门槛、交付能力四个维度展开。

报告需要给出：各维度的判断依据与数据来源、分市场的综合评价与优先级排序、建议的进入节奏与阶段目标、主要风险与应对方案。最后要明确指出哪些市场建议进入、哪些建议观望、哪些建议暂缓。

academic-outline.label: 论文大纲
academic-outline.prompt: 请根据我的研究主题设计一份学术论文大纲，包含研究问题、理论框架、方法、结果与讨论，并说明各部分写作重点。

academic-review.label: 文献整理
academic-review.description: 提炼文献并建立研究脉络
academic-review.prompt: 请整理我提供的文献，按主题、方法和结论分类，提炼关键观点并指出相互支持、矛盾和可引用之处。

academic-method.label: 研究方法
academic-method.description: 选择合适的方法与实验方案
academic-method.prompt: 请根据研究目标和可用数据，比较可选研究方法，给出推荐方案、变量设计、样本要求、实施步骤和潜在局限。

academic-polish.label: 学术润色
academic-polish.description: 提升表达的准确性与连贯性
academic-polish.prompt: 请将我提供的论文段落润色为规范、清晰、严谨的学术中文，保留原意，并列出关键修改理由。

academic-data-analysis.label: 数据与统计
academic-data-analysis.description: 问卷数据的统计方法与结果
academic-data-analysis.prompt:
请帮我完成论文中数据处理与统计分析的写作，研究对象是问卷调研数据。

需要包含：变量与测量方式的对应表、缺失值处理说明、信效度检验指标的呈现方式、每个研究问题对应的统计方法与输出、结果部分的规范写法。要说明为什么选用该统计方法，不能只罗列公式。

academic-grant.label: 开题报告
academic-grant.description: 研究计划书与开题报告要点
academic-grant.prompt:
请帮我整理一份研究计划书的写作框架，用于开题报告与基金申请。

需要包含：立项依据与研究问题的提出方式、研究内容的分层拆解与关键问题、技术路线与研究方法、进度安排与阶段性成果、预期成果与创新点、经费与可行性说明。每一部分都要说明评委最关注什么。

docs-meeting.label: 会议纪要
docs-meeting.description: 整理讨论内容与行动项
docs-meeting.prompt: 请把我提供的会议记录整理成正式会议纪要，包含议题、关键结论、待办事项、负责人和截止时间。

docs-report.label: 工作报告
docs-report.description: 生成结构清晰的正式报告
docs-report.prompt: 请根据我提供的材料撰写一份正式工作报告，包含背景、进展、数据、问题、建议和下一步计划。

docs-summary.label: 文档摘要
docs-summary.prompt: 请阅读我提供的文档，输出简明摘要、关键事实、重要结论、风险点和需要进一步确认的问题。

docs-polish.label: 文档润色
docs-polish.prompt: 请润色我提供的文档，改善语法、措辞、结构和正式程度，保留原有事实与意图，并给出修改后的完整版本。

docs-prd.label: 需求文档
docs-prd.description: 产品需求说明与验收标准

docs-notice.label: 通知公告
docs-notice.description: 内部通知与公告文书起草

pptx-work-report.label: Work Report
pptx-work-report.description: Quarterly summary and next phase planning report
pptx-work-report.prompt:
Create a quarterly work report PPT with the following content:

1. Review of core work achievements this quarter
2. Key project progress and milestone completion
3. Performance metrics completion (visualized with charts)
4. Problems encountered and solutions
5. Team collaboration highlights
6. Next quarter work plans and objectives
7. Resource support needed

Style requirements: Concise business style, clear logic, data visualization, suitable for management reporting.

pptx-content-research.label: Industry Research
pptx-content-research.description: Industry trends and competitor analysis report
pptx-content-research.prompt:
Create an industry research and analysis report PPT covering the following sections:

1. Research background and objectives
2. Overall industry development status and market size
3. Main competitor comparison (features, pricing, user reputation)
4. Target user persona and core needs insights
5. Industry trends and opportunities summary
6. Actionable strategy recommendations

Style requirements: Data-driven, rich in charts, well-reasoned viewpoints, suitable for internal team sharing and discussion.

pptx-education.label: Educational Presentation
pptx-education.description: Classroom teaching slides and knowledge explanation
pptx-education.prompt:
Create a popular science teaching courseware about "Solar System and Planetary Exploration" suitable for middle school classroom use, including:

1. Overview of the Solar System
2. Comparison of basic characteristics of the eight planets (size, distance, temperature, etc.)
3. Earth's uniqueness - why it is suitable for life
4. Important milestones in human space exploration
5. Classroom interactive Q&A session (design 3-4 thinking questions)
6. Extended reading recommendations

Style requirements: Vivid and lively, bright colors, content from shallow to deep, stimulating students' curiosity and desire to explore.

pptx-ai-intro.label: Introduction to AI
pptx-ai-intro.description: Popular science presentation for understanding AI basics
pptx-ai-intro.prompt:
Create a popular science PPT introducing artificial intelligence for beginners, including:

1. What is artificial intelligence - explain with everyday examples
2. Brief history of AI development (from Turing Test to large language models)
3. Common AI application scenarios (voice assistants, recommendation systems, autonomous driving, etc.)
4. Basic principles of machine learning (explained with intuitive analogies)
5. How large models and ChatGPT work
6. What AI can and cannot do
7. How ordinary people can start using AI tools to improve efficiency

Style requirements: Easy to understand, use diagrams and analogies, avoid technical jargon, make it understandable even for those with no technical background.

3. Mark outliers and key data points

1. Extract all table data from the image
2. Organize into standard row and column format
3. Correct possible recognition errors
4. Generate a clearly formatted Excel file.

word-report.label: Data Report

word-report.prompt:
Please generate a Word analysis report based on the data file I provided, with the following requirements:

1. Include data overview description
2. Core metrics statistics and trend analysis
3. Key findings and conclusion summary
4. Professional layout, clear structure, ready for reporting.

multi-excel-merge.label: Merge Multiple Tables
multi-excel-merge.description: Merge multiple Excel files and standardize format
multi-excel-merge.prompt:
I have multiple Excel files that need to be merged and organized. Please help me:

1. Merge data from multiple files into one table
2. Standardize column names and data formats
3. Remove duplicate data
4. Generate a merged Excel file with data source markers.

edu-english-words.label: English Vocabulary
edu-english-words.prompt:
I am preparing for the CET-4 exam. Please help me organize a high-frequency core vocabulary learning list with the following requirements:

1. Select 20 high-frequency must-know words
2. Provide phonetic symbols, Chinese definitions, and a short example sentence for each word
3. Group by theme (such as campus life, work, technology, etc.)
4. Provide a quiz at the end to help me test my memory.

edu-math-explain.label: Math Problem Explanation
edu-math-explain.description: Detailed solution process for math problems
edu-math-explain.prompt:
Please explain the following mathematical knowledge in an easy-to-understand way:

Problem: Solve the quadratic equation 2x² + 3x - 5 = 0

Requirements:
1. First review the general form of quadratic equations and the quadratic formula
2. Show the complete substitution and calculation process step by step
3. Analyze the nature of roots using the discriminant
4. Finally verify if the answer is correct
5. Provide a similar practice problem for me to consolidate.

edu-essay-writing.label: Essay Writing Guidance
edu-essay-writing.prompt:
Please provide essay writing guidance on the topic "My Most Unforgettable Trip":

1. First provide a clear writing outline (structural suggestions for introduction, body, and conclusion)
2. Share 3 techniques to make the article more vivid (such as detailed description, sensory description, scene-based emotion)
3. Write a sample opening paragraph to show how to attract readers
4. List 5 good words and sentences that can be used in this essay
5. Remind common writing problems and pitfalls to avoid.

edu-knowledge-explain.label: Knowledge Explanation
edu-knowledge-explain.description: Explain complex knowledge in simple language
edu-knowledge-explain.prompt:
Please explain the concept of "photosynthesis" in easy-to-understand language:

1. Summarize what photosynthesis is in one sentence
2. Explain the principle with everyday life analogies
3. Draw a simple process of photosynthesis (text-based flowchart)
4. Explain the importance of photosynthesis for Earth and humanity
5. Propose 3 thinking questions to help me deepen my understanding.

research-industry.label: Industry Trends
research-industry.description: Map the market and its direction
research-industry.prompt: Conduct deep research on the industry I specify, covering market size, key players, trends, opportunities, risks, and source-backed conclusions.

research-competitors.label: Competitor Analysis
research-competitors.prompt: Prepare a competitor analysis comparing positioning, users, features, pricing, strengths, weaknesses, and differentiation opportunities in a table.

research-policy.label: Policy Analysis
research-policy.prompt: Analyze the policy or regulation I provide, extracting requirements, scope, dates, business impact, and implementation advice while flagging uncertainty.

research-literature.label: Literature Review
research-literature.prompt: Create a literature review framework for the topic, summarizing methods, consensus, disagreements, gaps, and follow-up research questions.

research-user.label: User Research
research-user.prompt:
Please run a round of target user research and produce a report. The subjects are frontline users, and the focus is the problems they hit in real work.

The report should cover the sample composition and method, the current workflow and where it breaks down, a ranked list of needs with the reasoning behind it, representative quotes, and concrete product recommendations. Every conclusion needs a stated source, not just an opinion.

research-market-entry.label: Market Entry
research-market-entry.description: Feasibility study for a new market
research-market-entry.prompt:
Please assess the feasibility of entering the market I specify, across four dimensions: demand size, acquisition cost, compliance burden, and delivery capability.

The report should include the evidence and sources behind each dimension, an overall ranking of the candidate markets, a staged entry plan with goals for each stage, and the main risks with mitigations. Close by stating clearly which markets to enter, which to watch, and which to defer.

academic-outline.label: Paper Outline
academic-outline.prompt: Design an academic paper outline for my topic with research questions, framework, methods, results, and discussion, including writing guidance for each section.

academic-review.label: Literature Notes
academic-review.prompt: Organize the literature I provide by topic, method, and conclusion; extract key claims and identify support, contradictions, and useful citations.

academic-method.label: Research Method
academic-method.prompt: Compare research methods for my objective and data, then recommend a design with variables, sample needs, steps, and limitations.

academic-polish.label: Academic Editing
academic-polish.prompt: Edit the paper passage I provide into precise, coherent academic English while preserving meaning, and list the key revisions.

academic-data-analysis.label: Data and Statistics
academic-data-analysis.description: Statistical methods and results for survey data
academic-data-analysis.prompt:
Please help me write the data processing and statistical analysis section of my thesis. The subject is survey data.

Include a table mapping variables to measurement methods, how missing values were handled, how reliability and validity are reported, the statistical method matched to each research question with its output, and the conventional way to write up results. Explain why each method was chosen rather than listing formulas.

academic-grant.label: Research Proposal
academic-grant.description: Proposal outline for thesis or grant application
academic-grant.prompt:
Please put together a writing framework for a research proposal, for a thesis opening report or a grant application.

Include how to frame the rationale and the research question, a layered breakdown of the research content with its key questions, the technical route and methods, the schedule with staged deliverables, expected outcomes and contributions, and the budget and feasibility notes. For each part, note what reviewers look for.

docs-meeting.label: Meeting Minutes
docs-meeting.prompt: Turn my meeting notes into formal minutes with agenda, decisions, action items, owners, and due dates.

docs-report.label: Work Report
docs-report.prompt: Write a formal work report from my materials covering background, progress, data, issues, recommendations, and next steps.

docs-summary.label: Document Summary
docs-summary.prompt: Read the document I provide and return a concise summary, key facts, conclusions, risks, and questions requiring confirmation.

docs-polish.label: Document Editing
docs-polish.prompt: Edit my document for grammar, wording, structure, and appropriate formality while preserving facts and intent, then provide the complete revised version.
